name: tadazz
description: Create quiz drafts and custom theme/game packages, preview their native show, and choose when to save them to your Tadazz account.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit quiz drafts or complete packages with custom themes and bundled media. Check live authoring capabilities, upload a package, build it with the native isolated worker, and preview its game in Tadazz. Explicit save and install requests write directly to your account without a second confirmation or independent review for private themes. Account access, exact-version checks, validation, and isolated theme execution remain in place. Preview interactions are demonstrations and do not cast live votes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a five-question quiz draft in Tadazz and show its interactive preview.
